name: diabeteschain-load-tests
description: k6 load tests for DiabetesChain backend thesis metrics.

scripts.write:e1: k6 run -e SCENARIO=E1 -e TOTAL_RECORDS=50 -e VUS=5 --summary-export results/write_E1_50.json scripts/write-load.js
scripts.write:e2: k6 run -e SCENARIO=E2 -e TOTAL_RECORDS=100 -e VUS=10 --summary-export results/write_E2_100.json scripts/write-load.js
scripts.write:e3: k6 run -e SCENARIO=E3 -e TOTAL_RECORDS=500 -e VUS=20 --summary-export results/write_E3_500.json scripts/write-load.js
scripts.write:e4: k6 run -e SCENARIO=E4 -e TOTAL_RECORDS=1000 -e VUS=30 --summary-export results/write_E4_1000.json scripts/write-load.js
scripts.write:e5: k6 run -e SCENARIO=E5 -e TOTAL_RECORDS=2000 -e VUS=50 --summary-export results/write_E5_2000.json scripts/write-load.js
scripts.read:e1: k6 run -e SCENARIO=E1 -e TOTAL_READS=50 -e VUS=5 --summary-export results/read_E1_50.json scripts/read-load.js
scripts.read:e2: k6 run -e SCENARIO=E2 -e TOTAL_READS=100 -e VUS=10 --summary-export results/read_E2_100.json scripts/read-load.js
scripts.read:e3: k6 run -e SCENARIO=E3 -e TOTAL_READS=500 -e VUS=20 --summary-export results/read_E3_500.json scripts/read-load.js
scripts.read:e4: k6 run -e SCENARIO=E4 -e TOTAL_READS=1000 -e VUS=30 --summary-export results/read_E4_1000.json scripts/read-load.js
scripts.read:e5: k6 run -e SCENARIO=E5 -e TOTAL_READS=2000 -e VUS=50 --summary-export results/read_E5_2000.json scripts/read-load.js
